messages:
maria: Quick follow-up thread from the security/privacy breakout. Leadership asked for clarifications on a few topics we skimmed: key escrow policy, long-term log retention & e-discovery, data residency, and pentest cadence. Please drop short answers and action items.

sam: Short answers first. Key escrow: we do not escrow customer BYOK keys by default. For private deployments we support customer-provided keys only. For hosted customers who request escrow, that's a rare enterprise add-on with strict legal controls.

jordan: Data residency: GA will let customers pick region for control-plane data and for log sinks. We will also offer guaranteed EU-only control plane for specific contracts (legal review required).

nina: On legal hold / e-discovery: retention beyond contractual retention will require a signed legal-hold addendum. We cannot unilaterally retain longer for discovery without contractual terms and security review.

alex: From sales: customers keep asking about emergency access to keys if a key owner leaves. We need a clear policy to present.

sam: Policy draft: BYOK implies customer is responsible for key lifecycle. For Dedicated/Private we can offer an optional escrow with multi-party control (3-person quorum), audit logging, and sealed custody. This will be an expensive add-on and needs legal approval.

cam: Ops question: if we do escrow, who runs the escrow KMS? Our KMS or a third-party custodian?

nina: Legal prefers third-party custodians for strong separation, but we can support both. Must include SLAs and chain-of-custody documentation.

ops-oncall: Log retention SLA: we can guarantee export availability within 24h to customer sink. For archived logs retrieval beyond 1 year the TAT increases (we'll document costs).

alex: Customers also want pseudonymized logs for compliance. Can we offer a log redaction/pseudonymization pipeline before export?

jordan: Yes, we can add a pipeline stage to hash or redact PII fields before shipping. It'll be configurable per-tenant and applied at the sink stage. We should add presets for common GDPR/HIPAA patterns.

sam: Pentest cadence: we expect external pen test annually for Hosted + Dedicated; Private/on-prem depends on contract. We will publish a summary report and offer redacted findings under NDA.

nina: Also add a clause: customers can request a tailored assessment as part of onboarding but it will be scoped and billed.

maria: Can someone capture a single-line customer-facing FAQ for these items? Needs to be non-technical: BYOK = you control keys; escrow = optional; logs = exported to your bucket; retention = contract-defined; residency = choose region; pen tests = yearly.

sam: I'll write a draft 2-3 sentence FAQ plus an ops FAQ with links.

alex: I'll validate with Sales and list customers who asked for escrow/residency guarantees.

jordan: Action: infra to spec pseudonymization presets and a config flag for sink processing. Target doc PR by next Thurs.

cam: Ops will draft escrow runbook and third-party vendor shortlist.

maria: Great. Meeting to stitch comms: Thursday 9:30 PT?

ops-oncall: Works for Ops.

alex: Works for Sales.

sam: I'll be there.
